metadata.name: Porites coral geochemical and isotopic proxy data from French Polynesia
metadata.description: High-resolution geochemical (Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca) and isotopic (δ18O, δ13C) measurements from a single Porites coral core (TIAREI-A1) collected in French Polynesia. The dataset contains 96 samples spanning approximately 8 years (1999.7–2007.6) of paleoclimate proxy data, sampled at a fixed location at 15m depth. The core was collected on 2008-07-01.
metadata.temporal: Approximately 8 years (1999.7–2007.6), with sub-daily to daily resolution (~1.3 days per sample interval)
